schemaVersion.description: Generator schema version, always the component id.

title.description: Short title for students in plain text.

labelHeader.description: Header for the row-label column, 1 to 40 characters, for example Planet.

header.description: Value-column header as printed, 1 to 40 characters. It occurs in the quote.

unit.description: Unit label, 0 to 20 characters; empty string means no unit.

numeric.description: True when the column holds numbers parsed by parseTableNumber.

sourceId.description: Id of the source the quote was copied from.

quote.description: Exact characters copied from the source, no ellipsis, 150 characters or fewer. It contains the header.

label.description: Row label as printed, 1 to 60 characters. It occurs in the quote.

sourceId.description: Id of the source the quote was copied from.

quote.description: Exact characters copied from the source, no ellipsis, 150 characters or fewer. It contains the row label.

value.description: Cell value as printed, 1 to 40 characters. It is a whole token in the quote.

sourceId.description: Id of the source the quote was copied from.

quote.description: Exact characters copied from the source, no ellipsis, 150 characters or fewer. It contains the value as a whole token.

values.description: One value per column, in column order.

id.description: Lowercase kebab question id, 40 characters or fewer.

rowIndex.description: Row index for lookup, otherwise the -1 absent sentinel.

columnIndex.description: Column index the question asks about.

questions.description: Questions answered by our code, 1 to 4.

chartColumnIndex.description: Numeric column to chart, or the -1 absent sentinel for no chart.

enabled.description: True for the progressive-rate calculator, false otherwise.

rateColumnIndex.description: Rate column index, or the -1 absent sentinel when disabled.

overColumnIndex.description: Threshold column index, or the -1 absent sentinel when disabled.

exampleIncome.description: Example income greater than 0 when enabled, else the 0 absent sentinel.
